description: stuck-detector ticks and findings: sessions that stopped moving. Two record shapes share this store, discriminated by kind: an observation row (class, cwd, evidence, idle_s, session, slug, streak, would_page) and a run-summary row (findings, rc, ts). Each row carries only its own kind's fields (crew#71).

kind.description: discriminator between the two record shapes in this store: "observation" (class, cwd, evidence, idle_s, session, slug, streak, would_page) or "run_summary" (findings, rc, ts)
